description: Generate an equipment definition (assets/<namespace>/models/equipment/<id>.json at pack format 42.0, assets/<namespace>/equipment/<id>.json from 46.0) plus one 64x32 armor or elytra texture template per layer entry at assets/<namespace>/textures/entity/equipment/<layer type>/<texture>.png. Layer types are checked against the target version's client enum, entries may be dyeable or use the player texture, and only humanoid, humanoid_leggings and wings have a verified texture layout (template false writes the definition alone). Every target is checked before the first write, an occupied path refuses the whole batch unless force is true, and without outputDir the definition text and each template embed instead.

fill.description: Fill each template face with its face color; default true. false leaves the face areas transparent.

force.description: Replace existing output files; without it an occupied path refuses the batch.

id.description: Equipment definition id; one or more [a-z0-9._-] path segments. The definition lands at assets/<namespace>/(models/)equipment/<id>.json.

layers.description: One entry per layers.<type>[] item, in draw order.

dyeable.description: true writes dyeable: {}, an object writes color_when_undyed; omitted leaves the entry undyeable.

texture.description: Texture leaf below textures/entity/equipment/<type>/; defaults to the definition id.

type.description: Layer type the target version knows (humanoid, humanoid_leggings, wings, horse_body, ...).

usePlayerTexture.description: Write use_player_texture; only the wings layer reads it.

minecraftVersion.description: Release Minecraft version 1.19.3 through 26.3 (for example "1.19.3", "1.21.4", "26.3"). Omitted means engine defaults.

namespace.description: Asset namespace shared by the definition and its templates.

outputDir.description: Resource pack root receiving assets/. When omitted the definition text and each template (pngBase64, sourceText) are embedded and nothing is written.

resourcePackVersion.description: Target resource-pack version as N or N.M (e.g. 84, 97.1); normalized to major.minor. Omitted means engine defaults.

template.description: Write one texture template per layer entry; default true. Set false for a definition-only run, which is the only way to use a layer type without a verified layout.

name: equipment_asset
